name: Merge Conflict Kraken
description: Something ancient surfaces in `feature/checkout`. It has many arms and all of them are `<<<<<<< HEAD`.
onCounteredText: You talk through every conflicting line, one by one. The Kraken sinks back into `main`, sated.
onFailText: You resolve it by picking whichever side looks longer. Production disagrees with your choice.

name: Legacy jQuery Reawakens
description: A `$` appears in a file that shouldn't have one. Then another. The console fills with familiar, ancient warnings.
onCounteredText: You wrap it in a namespace and back away slowly. It goes still.
onFailText: It spreads to two more files before you can stop it.

name: 2FA Lockout
description: Your phone is at 2%. The code expires in 30 seconds. It is, of course, the worst possible moment.
onCounteredText: You plug in with seconds to spare and get the code through just in time.
onFailText: You're locked out for the rest of the sprint, refreshing a support ticket queue.

name: The Friday 5PM Deploy Curse
description: Someone deployed on a Friday. At 5:03 PM. On purpose.
onCounteredText: You roll it back before anyone notices. Mostly.
onFailText: You spend the weekend un-breaking production.

name: Off-By-One Error Eats a Day
description: The loop runs one too many times. Or one too few. It has already been six hours.
onCounteredText: You find the exact answer, third reply down, from 2011. It still works.
onFailText: You lose the whole day to it and ship a workaround instead of a fix.
